answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 45282 Country: KW Title: Dream Interpretation Question: We have 3 budgie birds in our home as a pet for the past 2 years. Now my sister is having a repeated same dream which is "we have 5 budgie bird and 1 baby bird as per her dream and all these birds are passing red coloured waste she was worried. Then a man with white clothes came to her with his hand cuffed and asked her to help him remove the hand cuff so that he can help her cure the bird she was confused and she said no to him then he laughed at her and went, after his departure the baby bird was dead. Please interpret this dream. Answer ID: 45282 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 996/955/N=1434) Your sister should not get annoyed with such dreams. She should do taubah and istighfar extensively. In future if she experiences such dreams then should read the following dua as soon as she gets up and spit out on her left side thrice and if night remains then you should turn her side and sleep again. أعوذ بالله من الشيطان وشر هده الرؤيا Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
